question: Has TCR initiated TDEC contact for the septic inspection, given the 2026-10-12 start requires contact by approximately 2026-09-01?
why_it_matters: TDEC takes 4-6 weeks end-to-end per addition CLAUDE.md; missing the contact window directly delays excavation and pushes the entire on-site schedule (fact: septic_tdec_required, scheduled_start_date).

question: Is a tankless water heater being installed, or does the contract scope only cover extending the existing gas WH vent through the new roof?
why_it_matters: Scope says 'extend existing WH vent' but breakdown prices a tankless WH option at $5,140 materials; this determines whether procurement.tank and plumbing.tank_set are on the critical path (fact: water_heater_scope_conflict).

question: Has the existing main electrical service amperage been verified to accept the new 100A subpanel without requiring a service upgrade?
why_it_matters: Addition CLAUDE.md requires an amperage check in pre-construction when a subpanel is in scope; the breakdown has no service upgrade section, leaving the assumption unverified (fact: electrical_subpanel_scope).

question: Has the roof framing method been decided — stick-frame or custom trusses — for the 3/12 addition roof?
why_it_matters: Scope explicitly marks this TBD; custom trusses require a 4-6 week supplier lead ordered at structural sign-off, which must be reflected in the procurement plan (fact: roof_pitch_transition).

question: Is a saddle or valley flashing detail specified in the drawings for the 3/12 addition roof tying into the existing 6/12 pitch?
why_it_matters: A pitch transition from 3/12 to 6/12 is a known leak risk; the scope and drawing set (A-01/A-02) do not appear to call out a specific tie-in detail at this junction (fact: roof_pitch_transition, drawings_designer).

question: Did the customer request any hall bath work (such as a shower swap) to be completed before the main job starts, or is all hall bath modification intended as mid-job retrofit?
why_it_matters: The 'Existing Hall Bath Mod' section (72 hours, -$1,714.20 net) is retrofit work outside the addition objective; if any of it is a customer-requested early item, it must be isolated into site_prep per Rule 4V to meet the customer's timing expectation (fact: hall_bath_mod_section).

question: Does the new addition floor or roof load actually bear on the LVL beam location, or can the LVL sub-chain run independently of the new exterior framing?
why_it_matters: Per addition CLAUDE.md, if the addition load doesn't bear on the LVL, both chains run in parallel; if it does, new framing gates on LVL completion — a meaningful critical-path difference on a 10-16 week job (fact: lvl_beam_spec).

question: Is the 4'x4' elevator shaft located inside the new addition footprint or does it extend into the existing structure?
why_it_matters: Shaft location is spatially ambiguous in the scope (Signal C retrofit detection); if in existing structure, it is a retrofit component independent of addition framing dependencies and must be isolated accordingly (fact: elevator_shaft_framed).
